caption: The drawing features two distinct pieces of clothing on a plain background, separated vertically by a faint central crease. On the left side, there is a pair of blue trousers adorned with black vertical panels that run down the sides of each leg and are bordered with a wavy, light-colored trim. The trousers have a high waistband with a button closure at the top and additional vertical trimming on the outside of the legs. On the right side, there is a matching blue jacket with a short, cropped cut and long sleeves. The jacket has black cuffs, a black collar, and black edging, with decorative light-colored embroidery on the cuffs, lower front, and chest. The jacket’s front is slightly open, showing an interior patterned lining. Both garments are drawn with attention to detail, particularly in the depiction of texture and trim, and they are presented against a plain, cream-colored background.
title: Jacket and Pants
